of.description: A point-in-time sum or count metric, evaluated per entity at two instants.

key.description: The entity column in that metric's source.

prior.description: The reference instant: this long before the evaluation instant.

where.description: Condition over current and prior that fixes the entities, such as prior > 0. Default: every entity.

expr.description: Combines one entity's two values before aggregating, such as least(current, prior). Default current. An entity missing at an instant counts as 0.

aggregate.description: sum (default) of expr, or count of entities that pass where.

group_at.description: When a block splits by a column, which instant gives an entity its group. Default current, falling back to prior.

data.description: Swap sources for fixture files, by source name.

column.description: Column to aggregate. Required except for count, where it counts non-null values; without it, count counts rows.

value.description: Row expression to aggregate instead of a column, such as price * quantity.

segments.description: Segments always applied: names of files under segments/.

time.description: Date or timestamp column that places rows in time. Needed for time series and period comparison.

over_time.description: sum (default) adds rows over a bucket. last, first, avg, min, max make the metric point-in-time: read a snapshot, or each entity's latest row when entity is set.

entity.description: With over_time last or first: the key whose state each row describes; its latest row carries forward.

from.description: Row expression: the instant the row starts counting.

to.description: Row expression: the instant it stops counting; null means it never stops.

ends.description: Whether a row whose interval ends exactly at a bucket end still counts in that bucket. Default inclusive.

active.description: Makes the metric point-in-time: a row counts at every instant in [from, to). Replaces time.

trailing.description: Makes the metric point-in-time: at each instant, aggregate the rows of this length before it.

scale.description: Constant multiplier applied after aggregation, such as 0.01 or 12.

oneOf.description: The value is a fraction: 0.124 shows as 12.4%.

Format.description: How values of this metric are shown.

column.description: A column name in the source data.
A column name in the source data.

key.description: The column of that source to match against.

oneOf.description: Keeps rows whose column value appears (in_table) or does not appear (not_in_table) in another source's key column. A null value passes not_in_table and fails in_table.

Filter.description: A row filter. between is inclusive at both ends. A date (YYYY-MM-DD) compared with a timestamp column compares the row's calendar date in the project time zone, so eq matches the whole day and between includes all of its last day. neq and not_in keep rows whose column is null; the other operators never match null.
